# PR #2412: Patch: the AI prices a Dormant unit by the unit it wakes as

Closes #2380

## What changed

Until now the AI's evaluation counted a Dormant card on the field as an empty zone (R1839000). So it almost never played Imprisoned Cosmality or Imprisoned Ship Smith, and it ignored the player's. Now `material()` (`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`) walks `units_on_field_of` and values each Dormant card as the same card awake (its `unit_worth`), discounted:

- **With a countdown:** times `slumber_turn_share` for each turn left.
- **With no countdown** (it waits for an effect, like the Dormant Starship's launch): times `slumber_waiting_share`.

The two new `EvalWeights` fields are 0.5 in `AI_EVAL`, untuned, and 0.0 in the frozen `GREEDY_EVAL`. At a zero share `unit_worth` is never called, and a board with no Dormant card sums exactly as before. Nothing else in the AI changes: `legal_actions`, `face_threat`, the lethal solver and the learned features still use `active_units_of`, which leaves a Dormant card out.

- **Ruling:** a new ruling, R2380000 (`spec/rulings/R2380000.md`, §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/2380.md`), amends R1839000's two sentences about the AI. §6.1's Dormant row and §9.9's **Evaluation** bullet are updated to match.
- **Tests** (`crates/ai/tests/ai/slumber.rs`): the old test that pinned "a Dormant card counts for nothing" now keeps only its threat checks, as `r1839000_a_dormant_card_is_no_threat_until_it_wakes`. Six new `r2380000_…` tests cover:
  - the AI's own Dormant card scores above an empty zone, and an enemy one below it, by exactly `share × unit_worth`;
  - fewer turns left is worth more, on both sides;
  - a Dormant card with no countdown counts at the waiting share;
  - `GREEDY_EVAL` is bit-identical to an empty zone;
  - `decide` plays Imprisoned Cosmality on curve at Medium and at Hard;
  - two positions that differ only in a hidden hand card give the same decision.
- **Docs:** one sentence in `crates/ai/README.md` and one stale comment in `starship.rs`.

I followed the plan step by step. The one thing that differed from it: `spec/pending/` already exists on today's main, so `2380.md` just joins it.

## How I tested it

- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai slumber`: 10 passed.
- **The tests fail without the change.** With both shares set to 0.0 in `AI_EVAL`, 3 of the 6 new tests fail; the Cosmality test fails with `… cursor 0: EndTurn`. I put the config back afterwards.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`: 26, 648 and 94 passed; the 7 ignored are the existing daily sweeps.
- `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`: exit 0, all 37 test binaries ok, and `apps/web/src/wire` unchanged.
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `catalog check` and `patches check` all pass.
- **`classify --claims`:** I ran it with `--parent-bin` set to a build of `origin/main`, from a worktree at a temporary commit of this tree (made with a scratch index, no branch). It exits 0 with `classify: Internal`, so no patch fragment is needed.
- **`cargo jackioh gate` (smoke) passes**, exit 0:
  - ai-vs-random: 19 wins of 20 (17 needed)
  - ai-vs-greedy: 14 of 20 (10 needed)
  - hard-vs-easy: 17 of 20 (16 needed)

  It ran alongside the crate tests; its decisions read no clock, so the win counts don't depend on load.

### Sweep of `stinkyscape-017` and `stinkyscape-019`, pass 2 (affordable turns / plays)

I ran `cargo jackioh sweep stinkyscape-017 stinkyscape-019` twice on the same seeds: once with this change, and once with a build of `origin/main` as the baseline. Both exited 0 with no errors or timeouts. The issue's numbers come from the full-catalog sweep of record, which deals different games, so the baseline column is the like-for-like comparison.

| Card | Tier | Issue (sweep of record) | Baseline, same seeds | With this change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Imprisoned Ship Smith | Easy | 46 / 1 | 63 / 3 | 68 / 5 |
| Imprisoned Ship Smith | Hard | 41 / 2 | 38 / 0 | 37 / 1 |
| Imprisoned Cosmality | Easy | 64 / 3 | 80 / 0 | 61 / 8 |
| Imprisoned Cosmality | Hard | 110 / 1 | 37 / 0 | 30 / 3 |

All four baseline rows were flagged `neverPlayed`; all four rows with the change read `cleared`. Hard still plays these cards rarely; see the last point below.

## Decisions the issue left open

- **Discount shape:** the share is raised to the power of the turns left, so "Dormant for 2 turns" counts a quarter of the unit at 0.5. I rejected a linear discount and a flat share: a power keeps "sooner is worth more" for any countdown length.
- **Starting values:** both shares start at 0.5, untuned, like #1886's training-lane starts. I rejected counting the card in full (it can neither attack nor block yet) and pricing it by its cost (2 mana for a 10/6).
- **Awake value:** the card is valued as a copy of itself with the Dormant status cleared, so auras apply as they would once it wakes.

## Worth a second look

- **The Dormant Starship.** When it stands in the backrow it now counts at `slumber_waiting_share` on top of the backrow's price by its printed cost. Repricing it is the issue's follow-up, and `starship.rs` passes unchanged.
- **Hard barely moves in real games.** The learned correction's `features_of` (`crates/ai/src/features.rs`) reads `active_units_of`, so to it playing a Dormant card looks like losing a hand card. Letting Hard see these cards needs a new feature layout and a refit, which belongs in a follow-up issue.

# #2380: Patch: the AI prices a Dormant unit by the unit it wakes as
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Some new cards arrive asleep and wake a few turns later as a big unit. Imprisoned Cosmality, for example, costs 2 mana and wakes as a 10/6. To the practice AI a sleeping unit is worth nothing until it wakes. So the AI almost never plays these cards itself, and it doesn't prepare for the player's. Once this is built, the AI values a sleeping unit by what it will become, less the longer it has to wait. It plays these cards on curve and takes the player's seriously.

## Why

- `material()` (`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs:453-458`) sums `unit_worth` over `active_units_of` only, and that leaves a Dormant card out (R1839000: "It is no Unit … the AI's evaluation and its lethal solver").
- That choice was made before any Dormant card shipped:
  - R1839000 says "No shipped card is Dormant yet".
  - The AI test file's header says the same (`crates/ai/tests/ai/slumber.rs:7-8`).
  - The test pins "Its own Dormant card counts for nothing either, until it wakes" (`slumber.rs:95-117`).
- The latest sweep of record (`training/history/sweep-2026-10-29-2.md`) shows how rarely the AI plays these cards:

| Card | Easy: affordable turns / plays | Hard: affordable turns / plays |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Imprisoned Cosmality (`stinkyscape-019`) | 64 / 3 | 110 / 1 |
| Imprisoned Ship Smith (`stinkyscape-017`) | 46 / 1 | 41 / 2 |
| Spacemine (a 2-cost unit), for comparison | 30 / 14 | 35 / 12 |

- A Dormant card's status and countdown are on both seats' views (`UnitView.slumber`, R185), so pricing it uses no hidden information.

## Proposal

- In `material()`, add a term for each Dormant card on the side (`units_on_field_of` keeps them): the `unit_worth` of the card awake, times a named discount for each turn left on its countdown.
- A card that waits for an effect to wake it, with no countdown, counts at a named share.
- The weights are named in `EvalWeights` and `AI_EVAL`. `GREEDY_EVAL` keeps 0, since it is frozen.
- Nothing else changes:
  - `legal_actions` still never offers an action through or onto a Dormant card;
  - the face-threat and lethal reads still ignore it until it wakes.
- A new ruling amends R1839000's sentence on the AI's evaluation.

## Where it lands

- AI: `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, `crates/ai/tests/ai/slumber.rs` (the pinned test is rewritten under the new ruling), `crates/ai/README.md`.
- Spec: `spec/rulings/R1839000.md`, a new ruling note, `spec/pending/<issue>.md`. SPEC §6.1 (Dormant) and §9's practice AI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Tests named after the new ruling:
  - the AI's own Dormant card scores above an empty zone, and an enemy one scores below it from the AI's side;
  - fewer turns left is worth more.
- [ ] With 2 mana and Imprisoned Cosmality its only play, `decide` plays it at Medium and Hard (today it ends the turn).
- [ ] Positions that differ only in a hidden card still give the same decision, and `GREEDY_EVAL` is unchanged.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh gate` passes at smoke size, and the PR reports a `sweep` of `stinkyscape-017` and `stinkyscape-019` next to the numbers above.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.

## Size and risks

Hard (AI work by CLAUDE.md rule 11): about 7 files, 150 to 250 lines.

- The weights start untuned, as #1886's training-lane starts did. A small gate screen may not see a change confined to two cards.
- Any change to the evaluation can re-deal the seeded fixtures in the shadow-ban tests.
- The Dormant Starship hull in the backrow is still priced by its printed cost however many pieces have fused into it (`evaluate.rs:490-498`). That is left for a follow-up.
